fact: The state agency ANSUT, which leads the eGOUV e-government programme, developed an improved eConseil 2.0 platform in 2022 at the request of the government's General Secretariat, and began training of trainers on it on 10 September 2024.
title: Côte d'Ivoire : La plateforme eConseil 2.0, vitrine de la numérisation des archives de l'Etat (ANSUT)
